# @crup/react-timer-hook full AI context

## Install

```sh
npm install @crup/react-timer-hook@alpha
pnpm add @crup/react-timer-hook@alpha
```

## Exports

```ts
import { durationParts, useTimer, useTimerGroup } from '@crup/react-timer-hook';
```

## useTimer

```ts
useTimer({
  autoStart?: boolean;
  updateIntervalMs?: number;
  endWhen?: (snapshot: TimerSnapshot) => boolean;
  onEnd?: (snapshot: TimerSnapshot, controls: TimerControls) => void | Promise<void>;
  schedules?: TimerSchedule[];
  debug?: TimerDebug;
})
```

Use `now` for wall-clock countdowns and clocks. Use `elapsedMilliseconds` for stopwatches and pausable duration countdowns.

## useTimerGroup

Use `useTimerGroup()` for many keyed timers that each need independent lifecycle controls.

## Schedules

Schedules are app-owned side effects. Default overlap behavior is `skip`.

Schedule callbacks receive `(snapshot, controls, context)`. `context` includes `scheduleId`, `scheduledAt`, `firedAt`, `nextRunAt`, `overdueCount`, and `effectiveEveryMs`.

## Recipes index

Basic:
- `/recipes/basic/wall-clock/`: `new Date(timer.now)`.
- `/recipes/basic/stopwatch/`: render `timer.elapsedMilliseconds`.
- `/recipes/basic/absolute-countdown/`: `Math.max(0, expiresAt - timer.now)`.
- `/recipes/basic/pausable-countdown/`: `durationMs - timer.elapsedMilliseconds`.
- `/recipes/basic/manual-controls/`: use `start`, `restart`, and `reset`.

Intermediate:
- `/recipes/intermediate/once-only-on-end/`: `onEnd`.
- `/recipes/intermediate/polling-schedule/`: `schedules`.
- `/recipes/intermediate/poll-and-cancel/`: call `controls.cancel(reason)`.
- `/recipes/intermediate/backend-event-stop/`: call `timer.cancel(reason)` from a subscription.
- `/recipes/intermediate/debug-logs/`: opt in with `debug.logger`.

Advanced:
- `/recipes/advanced/many-display-countdowns/`: one shared `useTimer`.
- `/recipes/advanced/timer-group/`: `useTimerGroup`.
- `/recipes/advanced/group-controls/`: `pauseAll` and `resumeAll`.
- `/recipes/advanced/per-item-polling/`: item `schedules`.
- `/recipes/advanced/dynamic-items/`: `add`, `update`, `remove`.

## MCP

Local docs MCP server:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "react-timer-hook-docs": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/react-timer-hook/mcp/server.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Non-goals

No formatting, no timezone handling, no mode enums, no data-fetching cache, and no raw timeout handle exposure.
